breadboard.why: Provides connected rows and power rails for building the circuit.

place:esp32_1.why: Positions the ESP32 pins so they can connect to the power rails and sensor wiring.
place:esp32_1.tip: The board must straddle the center trench so pins on opposite sides stay electrically separate.

power:esp32_1.why: Connects the ESP32 3.3 V output and ground to the breadboard power rails.
power:esp32_1.tip: The positive rail is fed from 3.3 V, not VIN.

place:dht_pullup.why: Places a resistor between the DHT data connection and the positive supply connection.

power:dht_pullup.why: Connects the resistor to the positive supply so it can pull the DHT data line high.

place:air_1.why: Positions the SGP40 pins for power and I2C signal connections.

power:air_1.why: Supplies power and ground to the SGP40.
power:air_1.tip: Use the ground rail shared with the ESP32; an unshared ground leaves the sensor without a return path.

signal:air_1.why: Connects the SGP40 SDA and SCL lines to the ESP32 I2C pins.

place:dht_1.why: Positions the DHT22 pins for power, ground, and data connections.

power:dht_1.why: Supplies power and ground to the DHT22.

signal:dht_1.why: Connects the DHT22 data line to the ESP32 and the pull-up resistor.
signal:dht_1.tip: The two green wires share the data node, so keep both connected to the DHT data row.

place:soil_1.why: Prepares the soil moisture sensor for power and output connections.

power:soil_1.why: Supplies power and ground to the soil moisture sensor.
power:soil_1.tip: Its ground must share the ESP32 ground rail for the output signal to have a reference.

signal:soil_1.why: Brings the sensor's analog output onto the breadboard.

check.why: Confirms the assembly is ready for testing.
